Title: Current smokers
Label: Current Smokers
Subtitle: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report smoking at least 100 cigarettes and now report smoking every day or some days.
AgeAdjustment: Yes, to the US 2000 standard population
MethodsNote:
Current smoker is defined as having smoked at least 100 cigarettes in an entire life and currently smoking cigarettes everyday or some days.

Weighted to represent the NYC adult population, and to compensate for unequal probability of selection and nonresponse bias. Data by community district are weighted per the American Community Survey, 2015. Data for borough and NYC are weighted per the American Community Survey, 2014. The data source combined Financial District (MN 01) and Greenwich Village/Soho (MN 02), Clinton/Chelsea (MN 04) and Midtown (MN 05), Mott Haven/Melrose (BX 01) and Hunts Point/Longwood (BX 02), and Morrisania/Crotona (BX 03) and Belmont/East Tremont (BX 06). For these four pairs, the same estimate was applied to both CDs.
indicatorDetail: Smoking at least 100 cigarettes, and now report smoking every day or some days.
